Sam (People Ops): Noticed a mismatch between the interview rubric and the ATS export: 'culture_add' appears as 'cultural_fit' in CSVs. Can recruiters check recent exports?
Riley (Recruiter): Saw that too for two candidates. I think a renaming happened when we updated the engineer scorecard last month.
Tara (Hiring Manager): That's causing our dashboard filters to miss those scores. We pulled the wrong cohort for calibration.
Riley (Recruiter): Quick fix: I'll update the export mapping to accept both keys and backfill the missing field for active candidates.
ops-bot: :information_source: Backfill job queued (job id 9876).
Sam (People Ops): Please log the change and add a note to the recruiter playbook: "When renaming rubric fields, update export mappings and run backfill."
Riley (Recruiter): Logged in #recruiting and added a checklist item. Backfill running now.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Backfill completed for 4 candidates.
Tara (Hiring Manager): Thanks. Can we also add a short step to interviewer training to avoid free-text renames (use the form admin UI)?
Sam (People Ops): Good idea. I'll add a one-slide note in the interviewer quick-ref and schedule a 10-min sync with recruiters.
Riley (Recruiter): Will share the mapping snippet I used so eng can add validation tests.
